what_is_timed: Exact cosine search over 3,000 Person embeddings at 384 dimensions, returning the nearest 20. In-process over BLOB columns per ADR-0021, not through a loadable extension. Includes reading every row back out of SQLite, which is the dominant cost and the one a real query pays.
supersedes: runtime.md §4's 0.3 ms row, which was measured on asg017/sqlite-vec 0.1.9 — a different project from the extension §4.3 named, and a different implementation from the one ADR-0021 settled on.
embeddings: Synthetic, from InMemoryEmbedder. This measures the index and not retrieval quality, which stays an eval-set question (runtime.md §4.2).
